title: Canary Shield: end-to-end accuracy sentinel for mixed-precision rollouts
creator: Asha Menon
description: Build an automated end-to-end accuracy sentinel ("Canary Shield") that validates mixed-precision rollouts (FP8/INT8) against curated golden cohorts and rejects/auto-rolls back on statistical failure. This ticket covers harness orchestration, cohort sampling, metric selection (both semantic and token-level), pass/fail gate logic, and integration with the rollout controller for automatic mitigation.
acceptance_criteria: Canary job executes automatically for every canary rollout and scans configured golden cohorts
At least 3 orthogonal metrics computed per cohort: DeltaF1 (task-level), ResponseDriftScore (KL + embedding cosine), and TokenLogprobShift
Statistical test framework implemented (paired bootstrap + Holm-Bonferroni correction) and integrated into pass/fail decision
Automatic rollback or pin behavior triggered when any cohort exceeds preconfigured drift thresholds and the aggregate p-value is below alpha
Dashboard tile in Console shows per-cohort metric time-series, p-values, sample counts, and example diffs with links to failing prompts
Has CI smoke test that runs a tiny golden subset and verifies the gate decision logic in <5s on CI runners
comments: 2025-03-05 Asha Menon: Initial stubbed design for Canary Shield. Focus on mixed-precision because FP8/INT8 asymmetries showed context-length-sensitive regressions in earlier runs.

2025-03-07 Diego Alvarez: PoC for TokenLogprobShift metric implemented. Observed small but consistent left-shift in logprobs for INT8 on long-context queries. Need to validate across query length cohorts.

2025-03-09 Product feedback (Maya Chen): Require an approval step before auto-rollback for enterprise customers; add an opt-in policy per-tenant. Also requested audit trail entries for every canary decision.

2025-03-11 Design review (Lina Park): Suggested cohort UX for Console: show representative prompt, ground truth, baseline and canary outputs side-by-side with highlighted token differences. Will prototype tile.
2025-03-13 Diego Alvarez: Implemented paired bootstrap routine and basic Holm-Bonferroni multi-cohort correction. Added unit tests and synthetic golden injection tests.
2025-03-15 QA (Riley Thompson): Found nondeterministic failures in the small-CT test due to sampling nondeterminism. Suggested seeding and deterministic replay for CI artifacts.

2025-03-17 Asha Menon: Decided trade-offs: initial release will use conservative thresholds (lower false-positive rate) and human-in-the-loop approval for enterprise tenants; default for self-serve is automatic rollback. Security review flagged audit logging requirements.
2025-03-18 Diego Alvarez: Hooked up Console dashboard with time-series and example diffs. Next: expand golden families and add adversarial perturbation cohort by 2025-03-27.
